text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Let's hurry up and head back, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: Aren't you happy about taking first place?
Aren't you happy about taking first place?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm so happy I could dance! Buuut...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I've still got a ways to go, right? I gotta
win even
more races!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So I gotta hurry up and get stronger!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
I need to get first again and again and
again!
Then people will have to take me
seriously!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
And once everyone takes me seriously,
I'm sure
my friends will be thrilled!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Haru Urara really has changed from her
days of
just doing everything for fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finally has a real hunger for victory.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
choice_data_list: Then we're taking first place in the next race too!
Then let's take first place in the next race too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And... I wanna enter a G1!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
G1 races are a big deal, right? So I
wanna win
one!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
This is the first time Haru Urara has
asked for a
specific type of race! For a
moment, I'm taken
aback by her growth.
After a moment, though, I
make a
suggestion.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a sprint on a dirt course, which is
what she
excels at. I think she has a
great shot at getting
first!
choice_data_list: Then, what do you say to the 'JBC Sprint'?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'm gonna give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We set our sights on taking first place in
the JBC
Sprint!
